main_text.head: ANNVS CHRISTI MDXVII.
main_text.p: MArtinus Lutherus ubi refcivit, Tecelii moderata fua ad populū monita de vanitate Indulgentiarum, indignè ferre, in publico Academiæ Wittebergensi theatro contra impoſturas iſtas Pontificias ſibi diſputandum duxit.

Itaque Theses numero nonaginta quinq; pridie Kal. Novembris anni decimi ſeptimi ſupra millesimum quingentesimum foribus templi arcis affixit, quibus institorum Romanensium menſas evertit.a Esromus Rudingerus de origine Vbiquitatis.

page.notes: The "ANNVS CHRISTI MDXVII." line is a heading set in italic capitals; the body opens with a large initial M. The left margin note is partly illegible in the scan; its text is given as legible. The final line "fi do-" is printed at the right of the page and is a catchword-like fragment; no catchword is assumed. Text is 16th–17th century, with long s rendered as s. The page bears a "Digitized by Google" stamp, which is omitted.
